candidate_evidence.quote: OncoMAGNETX has developed a portable wearable noninvasive magnetic device (Oncomagnetic device) for the treatment of GBM.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The subject has a newly confirmed diagnosis of GBM per WHO classification criteria.

source_quote.quote: The subject has a confirmed unmethylated MGMT promoter status.

coder_notes: Device-only trial (Oncomagnetic device); no drug or biologic is registered. Conditions use 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' with no IDH or WHO 2021 reference, so cns5_terminology is historical. Blood biomarker collection for outcome correlation is mentioned in other outcomes but no specific molecular biomarker is named, so not coded.
